limits: Catalog and preset screen are built into the charts host; no general plugin-tab/catalog SDK.
Sensor calibrations are not supplied as field-verified defaults; depth inputs initially manual.
Windowed depth rate is not interval mechanical ROP with operation recognition.
Core and processor share bounded standard operations; not arbitrary heavy interpreter code in core.
Custom template library and IM2480 line history are not yet in JSONL backup; active calibration maps are.
UTC receipt time for graph ages/windows; backward clock resets windows. Monotonic core source freshness remains.
Mock-canvas timing is not a GPU or weak-machine benchmark.
No physical sensor, Windows 10, macOS, low-end machine, power-loss or 24-72h acceptance.
